[[File:SWGTCG_brainwashing_by_Yanner.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Brainwashing]]
'''Brainwashing''' was a tool used by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. One of their favored techniques was to use the [[synoptic teacher]] manufactured by [[Consolidated Learning Systems]].

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used [[hypno-imprinting]] to brainwash captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. The [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were then released and made their way back to the Rebel bases, where they spied on the Alliance without realizing what they were doing.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
